subject.title: fix(media-core): untrust audio/video MIME over generic ZIP sniff

question: Should the exported `detectMime` contract intentionally make generic ZIP/octet-stream byte evidence authoritative over audio and video extension or header claims while retaining document refinements such as XLSX?
rationale: The change fixes a real inconsistency and strengthens validation, but it changes observable behavior on a public plugin SDK helper and the existing public contract does not describe this rule.

options.title: Approve and document correction
options.body: Retain the implementation, align the public precedence documentation, and merge after exact-head checks complete.

options.title: Preserve current audio/video precedence
options.body: Decline or narrow the change if plugins must continue trusting audio/video metadata over generic container byte detection.

recommendation.title: Approve and document correction
recommendation.body: Retain the implementation, align the public precedence documentation, and merge after exact-head checks complete.
